assessment: Assignment changes and renames coincide with six and two affected exports, respectively; causation is unproved. Two analogies suggest separable selection and delay hypotheses. Neither demonstrates the six-day limit or next-40-export targets.

openings.claim: Adapt manufacturing kits: stable part numbers and a dated bill of materials become center-scoped course identities and a requested-week manifest, checked before CSV assembly. Names and current instructors become attributes rather than selection keys.
openings.delta: Failed correspondence: course splits need a predecessor/successor decision; they are not simple relabeling. Changed material assumptions: identities and historical membership must be recoverable, or coordinators must confirm membership privately. The manifest must not freeze attendance entry.
openings.prediction: If mutable selection attributes explain defects, a confirmed week manifest will reduce omissions after reassignment or renaming; split courses may remain ambiguous. Confirmation effort could erase the time benefit.
openings.probe: In fabricated staging, compare existing selection with dated manifests for reassigned, renamed, unchanged, and split courses. Six coordinators identify intended sets and time confirmation. Inspect tenant isolation while attendance entry continues. Retain the documented CSV; estimate implementation effort before selecting the change.
assumptions: Historical membership can be recovered or confirmed within the handling-time target.
Manifest creation and scoped selection fit six engineer-days and existing hosting.

openings.claim: Could a private export pickup counter remove replacement waiting, as a parcel locker separates collection from staff availability? Map authenticated center/week requests to job receipts and retrievable CSVs.
openings.delta: Failed correspondence: a ready parcel is already correct; a completed export can contain wrong courses. Changed material assumptions: coordinators can request replacements without staff intervention, and repeat demand is affordable.
openings.prediction: If staff handoff dominates delay, direct retrieval shortens request-to-download time while leaving course accuracy unchanged; active handling time may barely change.
openings.probe: During the two short sessions, compare assisted and direct replacement requests using fabricated files. Measure request-to-start, execution, download, checking, and import separately; observe concurrent attendance entry and reject cross-center retrieval attempts.
assumptions: Existing authentication and scheduling permit a small center-scoped retrieval flow within six days.
Replacement demand stays within hosting capacity; CSV schema remains supported.
